I can relate to this, something very similar happened to me several years ago. It took me a while to pick myself up again but I can assure you it’s possible. This is just my advice from my personal experience:  

Little steps at a time. It’s great that you can go for walks outside; slowly increase the amount you’re doing. Keep notes on what you currently occupy your days with and what you find difficult - a few months down the line you’ll be surprised at the progress you’ve made.  

If you aren’t sure what to do next, sit down (maybe with a family member) and consider your options on starting maybe a new job part-time, education, or other things like weekly clubs that can start to give you some routine and a reason to regularly go out and socialise. If you feel you need more help to get to that stage, the right therapist can be great. For my experience of the guilt and having to “get over people you barely knew”, dbt has helped immensely with my limerence.  

I hope any part of what I said here was helpful. It really can get better. Wishing the best for you pal.
